import urllib.request
import json

def get_pubchem_compound(name):
    url = f"https://pubchem.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/rest/pug/compound/name/{urllib.parse.quote(name)}/property/MolecularWeight,MolecularFormula,IUPACName,CanonicalSMILES/JSON"
    try:
        req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={'User-Agent': 'Mozilla/5.0'})
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req) as response:
            data = json.loads(response.read().decode())
            return data
    except Exception as e:
        return str(e)

import urllib.request
import json

def get_pubchem_cid(cid):
    url = f"https://pubchem.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/rest/pug/compound/cid/{cid}/property/MolecularWeight,ExactMass,MolecularFormula,IUPACName,CanonicalSMILES/JSON"
    req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={'User-Agent': 'Mozilla/5.0'})
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req) as response:
        return json.loads(response.read().decode())

def get_pubchem_by_name_or_cas(term):
    url = f"https://pubchem.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/rest/pug/compound/name/{urllib.parse.quote(term)}/property/MolecularWeight,ExactMass,MolecularFormula,IUPACName,CanonicalSMILES/JSON"
    req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={'User-Agent': 'Mozilla/5.0'})
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req) as response:
        return json.loads(response.read().decode())
